summary: Additional List (Wait List) validity for teaching post appointment; Karnataka Recruitment Rules Entry 66; six-month validity per executive instruction vs. recruitment rule continuity; no right to appointment from wait list; State discretionary power not arbitrary; High Court erred in directing appointment based on latches; appeal allowed; HC set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Karnataka Education Department Services (Department of Public Instructions) (Recruitment) Rules, 1967 Entry 66
Subha B. Nair & Ors. v. State of Kerala & Ors. (2008) 7 SCC 210
Shankarsan Dash v. Union of India (1991) 3 SCC 47
final_judgment: Civil Appeal allowed; High Court judgment (W.P. No. 51904 of 2019) set aside; no appointment direction restored.
